title.narrative: UNICEF continued to strengthen its;cross-sectoral;coordination mechanism to ensure that programmes are delivered in an effective and efficient manner, and cross cutting issues, such as climate change and youth participation, are mainstreamed.;UNICEF remained agile and responsiveas it refocused its work to provide lifesaving humanitarian assistanceduring the ongoing economic crisis. TheSri Lanka Country Office launched a Humanitarian Action for Children (HAC) appealanddeveloped a timely Contingency Plan in response to the crisis. Community engagement and social mobilization initiatives to promote COVID-19 protective practices and responsive measures, targeting the most vulnerable groups, including children, were strengthened.
